scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p tests --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
